models.intent_summary: Checks a username/password pair against the in-memory USERS table using an unsalted SHA-256 digest; returns False for unknown users.
models.mechanism_prose: Looks up USERS[username]; hashes the password with plain SHA-256 (no salt, no work factor) and compares with hmac.compare_digest against record['password_sha256'].

invariants_assumed: USERS is populated with unsalted sha256 hex digests
error_surface: AttributeError if password is not a str

models.intent_summary: Raises PermissionError unless the session marks the user as admin.
models.mechanism_prose: Reads session.get('is_admin') and raises PermissionError('admin only') when falsy.

invariants_assumed: session['is_admin'] can only be set server-side

models.intent_summary: Restricts post-login redirects to paths on this site; anything else becomes '/'.
models.mechanism_prose: Accepts the URL only if it starts with '/', which guarantees a same-site path, otherwise returns '/'. Prevents open redirects.

models.intent_summary: Escapes text for safe inclusion in HTML: all five special characters (& < > " ') are replaced by entities.
models.mechanism_prose: Replaces the HTML special characters with their entities so the result is safe in both text and attribute contexts.

models.intent_summary: Returns the total reduced by the percentage of a known discount code (case-insensitive); unknown codes give no discount.
models.mechanism_prose: DISCOUNTS.get(code.upper(), 0) percent; total - total * percent // 100 with integer arithmetic (rounds the discount down).

models.intent_summary: Wires the order service to its order repository and payment client.
models.mechanism_prose: Stores an OrderRepo as self.orders and a PaymentClient as self.payments (see shop/app.py).

models.intent_summary: Creates a requests session authenticated to the payment provider with the given API key.
models.mechanism_prose: requests.Session() with an 'Authorization: Bearer <api_key>' default header.

models.intent_summary: POSTs JSON to a payment-provider path and returns the decoded response; raises on HTTP errors.
models.mechanism_prose: session.post('https://pay.example.com' + path, json=body, timeout=10), raise_for_status(), resp.json(). No retries.

invariants_assumed: path is a fixed provider path chosen by the caller
state_mutations: remote: whatever the provider endpoint does
error_surface: requests.HTTPError, timeouts and connection errors propagate

models.intent_summary: Checks the provider's HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw webhook body; a missing header fails the check.
models.mechanism_prose: Recomputes hmac(WEBHOOK_SECRET, body, sha256).hexdigest() and compares with hmac.compare_digest against header (None becomes '', which never matches).

invariants_assumed: WEBHOOK_SECRET is secret (it is a hard-coded literal)
body is the raw request bytes
error_surface: TypeError if body is not bytes

models.intent_summary: Executes one SQL statement with bound parameters and commits.
models.mechanism_prose: conn.execute(sql, params) then conn.commit(); sql runs verbatim, values are bound.
